# The connection-alert icon assertion still lacks an expected-behavior message

The original and fixed accepted imageURL equality call pass the actual URL and platform-dependent expected URL without a message. The nearby text assertions have explicit expected-behavior messages. The wait-only repair neither adds nor repairs this existing assertion body. Keep this bounded diagnostic gap separate from the mock-signal change, and do not treat accepted historical absence as a preferred assertion pattern.

Scope: Get Messages test diagnostics.
